notes: Bundles Ace 1.44.0 (all minified noconflict modes, themes, workers and extensions in ace.zip), Chart.js 2.9.4 (the all-in-one bundle including Moment), jquery-contextmenu 2.10.2 with matching CSS/fonts, and jQuery UI Position 1.14.2. Chart.js stays on 2.x to preserve existing chartOptions; 4.x requires an API migration. Position is minified from the upstream source. jQuery itself is supplied by OpenAF. Default bundled functionality works with local assets; optional Ace extensions that integrate external services still require their own local configuration.
transforms: Concatenate jquery-ui/ui/version.js and ui/position.js, then minify using Google Closure Compiler SIMPLE.
ZIP all ace-builds/src-min-noconflict/*.js at the archive root.
